linux.policy: Independent actual POSIX file/probe measurements. Git is additionally capped by the corresponding pre-existing Windows ordinary/state ceiling; icacls and PowerShell stay zero. No Windows filesystem budget copied, no growth allowance added. A fresh fixed-source Linux run remains required.
